title: Shrinking-Tube Concentration for Adaptive Markovian Stochastic Approximation
summary: Adaptive algorithms increasingly make decisions while reshaping the dynamics that generate their future data. We establish a shrinking-tube concentration bound for projected stochastic approximation driven by an adaptive Markov chain. The bound guarantees, with high probability, that every iterate after a chosen time remains within a tolerance around the target that tightens over time.
